payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does comparison with the source show an added frog placement that constitutes progress toward putting a frog inside this toilet bowl?
node.criteria: Pass if source comparison establishes a newly added frog inside the bowl, or a visibly incomplete placement into the bowl such as a frog straddling the rim with part of its body extending into the interior. Describe whether the observed placement appears inside or incomplete, without awarding completion. Fail if comparison is sufficiently clear and shows no such requested progress. A frog solely on the lid, tank, floor, or outside the opening is not requested progress. Unknown if comparison, frog identity, or the relevant spatial relation cannot be assessed reliably; apparent proximity alone does not establish partial progress.
node.binding: Use s1 as candidate-identification context, then independently compare the source and edited images. Ground progress in a visible change toward the requested bowl-interior placement, not merely the addition of frogs elsewhere. Record the spatial evidence supporting progress or its absence.

dependencies.evidence: A recognizable green frog is visible inside the toilet bowl opening. Other frogs appear on the raised lid and nearby floor, but the bowl frog alone satisfies this check.
